headline: Claude trained on protein sequences at scale, expanding AI's biomedical capabilities
body: Anthropic's Claude model was trained on protein sequences at significant scale, marking a shift in foundation model development toward specialized biomedical data. This capability directly impacts healthcare AI by enabling faster drug discovery workflows, protein structure prediction, and genomic analysis without separate specialized models. For EHR vendors and health systems, integrated Claude-powered tools could accelerate clinical research pipelines and reduce time-to-insight for precision medicine initiatives. The move signals that general-purpose AI models are becoming viable infrastructure for clinical and research applications, reshaping vendor strategy in the diagnostic AI and drug discovery consulting space.
